name: euler2d_cone
title: 15 deg cone at Mach 2 (2D axisymmetric Euler, external_2d) vs Taylor-Maccoll

reference.quantity: Conical shock angle (fitted through the shock position at 6 stations)
reference.source: Sims (1964), NASA SP-3004, Table 11, p. 16: theta_w = 0.59192180 rad for theta_s = 15 deg, M = 2

reference.quantity: Surface pressure coefficient (mean between 30 % and 80 % of the cone length)
reference.source: Sims (1964), NASA SP-3004, Table 9, p. 14: Cp = 0.2022339 for theta_s = 15 deg, M = 2

study.title: Run
notes: Taylor-Maccoll (aeroflowsim.gasdynamics.taylor_maccoll) agrees with Sims (1964, NASA SP-3004, Tables 9 and 11) to 7e-5 in Cp and 2e-6 rad in the shock angle (tests/test_gasdynamics.py).
